intro: Maur Grimtotem was an emissary sent by Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem into the depths of Ragefire Chasm. Dispatched on an ill-fated diplomatic mission to the troggs infesting the subterranean tunnels beneath Orgrimmar, he met a brutal end at their hands. Today, only his remains and personal satchel linger in the dark as evidence of the foolish errand.

p: While most in the Horde view troggs as mindless, savage brutes beneath negotiation, Elder Crone Magatha Grimtotem thought otherwise—or at least claimed to. She dispatched Maur Grimtotem deep into the winding caverns of Ragefire Chasm beneath Orgrimmar to attempt a peaceful overture with the subterranean beasts. Predictably, diplomacy failed. Maur was swiftly slain, his corpse left in the caverns under the watchful eye of the trogg chieftain Oggleflint.
